integrity: All cited proofs in RESULT.md are included in this package; check_cone.py is a finite-support verification script. No independence or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns odd field characteristic, odd ambient dimension, and the full zero cone including its vertex; it does not cover the vertex-deleted cone, even characteristic, nonzero quadratic levels, or phase retrieval. Finite checks do not prove the infinite theorem. Independent validation and exhaustive historical-priority search were not performed.
title: Exact three-level self-Fourier spectrum on odd-dimensional quadratic cones
